name: hero-bg-desktop-01
prompt: A wide, calm background photograph for the top of a personal website. The left two thirds of the frame is an almost empty, evenly lit off-white plaster wall with a very fine matte texture, left clear for text. In the right third, morning sunlight passing through an unseen window casts the soft, blurred shadows of a few slender leaves and one thin vertical window frame onto the wall. The shadows are pale warm grey, faint and low in contrast, diffused at the edges. The view is straight-on to the wall; there is no floor, no furniture, no objects and no horizon. The style is a soft, quiet daylight photograph in a warm neutral palette: off-white plaster and pale stone, early-morning sunlight coming from the left, gentle diffused shadows with soft edges, a fine matte texture, low contrast, and a lot of calm empty space. Colours stay muted and close to warm white and light warm grey. The image contains no text, letters or numbers. No people appear.
